verdict.rationale: Docs confirm built-in Logfire integration that emits traces for the agent run with spans for every model request and tool call, giving a UI-based end-to-end trace of LLM calls and tool invocations; community testimony corroborates that execution is automatically traced and exportable to Logfire for observability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough of the Logfire UI itself and broader third-party observability tool support beyond Logfire.
